title: Mesangial Matrix Evaluation Protocol
author: Jeff Hodgin
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.562g9ge

steps.title: Deparaffinize and Rehydrate Slides
steps.instruction: Perform a series of washes to prepare the slides for staining.

substeps.instruction: Wash 2x 4 minutes in Xylene
Wash in 100% EtOH 2x 2 minutes
Wash in 95% EtOH 1x 2 minutes
Wash in 70% EtOH 1x 2 minutes
Rinse in dH2O

steps.title: Perform PAS Staining
steps.instruction: Stain the slides using Periodic Acid and Schiff’s reagent.

substeps.instruction: Incubate in 0.5% Periodic Acid solution for 5 minutes
Rinse 3x in dH2O
Incubate in Schiff’s reagent for 15 minutes (Note: Use fume hood or flow hood as reagent is light sensitive, mutagenic, and has a bad smell)
Rinse under running lukewarm tap water for 5 minutes

steps.title: Counterstain and Dehydrate
steps.instruction: Apply hematoxylin and dehydrate the slides for mounting.

substeps.instruction: Incubate in Hemotoxylin for 90 seconds
Rinse 6x in dH2O
Wash in 70% EtOH 1x 2 minutes
Wash in 95% EtOH 1x 2 minutes
Wash in 100% EtOH 2x 2 minutes
Incubate in Xylene for at least 5 minutes

steps.title: Mount Slides
steps.instruction: Secure the specimens with mounting medium and cover glass.

substeps.instruction: Apply 1 drop of mounting medium to slides
Carefully insert cover glass, avoiding bubbles

steps.title: Digitize Glomeruli Images
steps.instruction: Capture images of the glomeruli using calibrated equipment.

substeps.instruction: Calibrate camera and microscope and load values into MetaMorph® Program
Digitize 30 cortical glomeruli per case using a 40X lens, choosing glomeruli of similar maximal size diameter
Save images as uncompressed Tiff files

steps.title: Measure Glomerular Tuft Area
steps.instruction: Calculate the total area of the glomerular tuft in MetaMorph®.

substeps.instruction: Open the glomerulus Tiff file in MetaMorph® and scale the image to 50-75% to see the entire glomerulus
Outline the glomerular tuft using the polygon tool and double click to close
Go to Measure > Calibrate Distances, select the calibration file for the specific camera used, and choose Apply
Go to Measure > Region Measurements to calculate and record the glomerulus area

steps.title: Isolate and Threshold PAS Staining
steps.instruction: Isolate the tuft and define the color threshold for PAS stained areas.

substeps.instruction: Select the outlined tuft, go to Edit > Duplicate > Image, and close the full size image
Size the edited image to 150-200%
Go to Measure > Set Color Threshold and select Set By Example
Adjust color brightness and contrast using Display > Adjust Digital Contrast to optimize thresholding
Use the cursor to select the PAS stained area, clicking until the entire area is highlighted
Use 'Undo Last Click' to remove mistaken selections or check 'Reset color threshold range on next click' to clear all selections
Use OFF and Inclusive in the Set Color Threshold box to toggle between selected and unselected screens

steps.title: Quantify PAS Stained Area
steps.instruction: Perform morphometry analysis to determine the area of PAS staining.

substeps.instruction: Go to Measure > Integrated Morphometry Analysis
Under Set Up Parameters For, select Measuring > Total Area and Classifying > Total Area
Under Display, choose Summary
Under Show/Log Data, choose Current
Choose Measure; the 'area of PAS staining' is the last cell in the Summary window under Total
Choose Reset Current and then Close to exit the Integrated Morphometry Analysis box
